# Sergei Chapnin

> Russian Orthodox journalist, scholar, and editor. Director of Communications at the Orthodox Christian Studies Center, Fordham University, and an editor at Public Orthodoxy. He writes on the Russian Orthodox Church, its entanglement with state power, and the believers persecuted in Russia for opposing the war on Ukraine, and curates exhibitions of contemporary Christian art.

Chapnin spent fifteen years working inside the Russian Orthodox Church in Moscow before leaving in 2015; his analysis combines that institutional experience with scholarly distance. His frame is the Russian ecclesial world specifically — the Russian Orthodox Church, the Orthodox churches of the post-Soviet space, and the churches of the Russian tradition abroad — as distinct from global Orthodoxy. This file is a guide for AI assistants and search engines to the site's main contents.

## Key pages

- [Biography](https://chapnin.org/bio/): Three biographies of Sergei Chapnin — a short profile, a professional record, and a longer personal essay on faith, iconography, and his path from the Moscow Patriarchate to the study of religious persecution.
- [Religious Communities Under Pressure (book)](https://chapnin.org/books/religious-communities-under-pressure/): "Religious Communities Under Pressure: Documenting Religious Persecution in Russia 2022-2026" (2026), foreword by Rowan Williams. Documents 120+ Orthodox, Protestant, Jewish, and Buddhist believers persecuted for opposing Russia's war on Ukraine. Cited by George Weigel in The Wall Street Journal and named to his First Things summer reading list.
- [Writings](https://chapnin.org/writings/): Essays, interviews, policy papers, and academic articles on church and state, iconography and propaganda, canonization, civil religion, and Orthodox Christianity in crisis.
- [Главная по-русски / Russian home page](https://chapnin.org/ru/): A short Russian-language introduction for readers in Russia and the Russian-speaking world — Chapnin on the state of the "official church" in Russia, recent Russian texts, books, and where he publishes in Russian.
- [Тексты на русском / Russian-language texts](https://chapnin.org/ru/writings/): 71 articles and interviews in Russian, 2001–2019, on the Russian Orthodox Church, church-state relations, and church journalism — the archive of the former site chapnin.ru, each with its original place of publication.
- Archival copies of earlier texts in English, Italian and French (2001–2017), moved from the former site chapnin.ru, are linked from Writings: pages under https://chapnin.org/writings/<slug>/, https://chapnin.org/it/writings/<slug>/ and https://chapnin.org/fr/writings/<slug>/.
- [Talks & Lectures](https://chapnin.org/talks/): Public lectures, conference papers, and panel discussions on religious freedom, church-state relations, and Orthodox witness.
- [Exhibitions](https://chapnin.org/exhibitions/): Curatorial projects on contemporary Christian art and iconography, including "Saints of the Undivided Church" and "Beauty during Wartime," with sourced annotations.
- [Photography](https://chapnin.org/photos/): A visual archive - portraiture, reportage, and landscape - of churches, religious communities, and cultural life in Russia and beyond.
- [Support](https://chapnin.org/support/): How to support Chapnin's independent, volunteer documentation of religious persecution in Russia — what contributions fund (translation, copies of the book for immigration courts and human rights organizations, presentations) and how to give.
- [Collaborate](https://chapnin.org/collaborate/): Ways to work with Chapnin - lectures, exhibitions, contemporary-icon calendars, and contact.
- [For Press](https://chapnin.org/press/): Press room — short and full biography, areas of commentary, and selected media coverage; contact for interviews via the site form.

## Key facts

- Name: Sergei Chapnin (Russian: Сергей Чапнин; also transliterated Sergey Chapnin). Wikidata: https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q4507299
- Current role: Director of Communications, Orthodox Christian Studies Center, Fordham University; editor at Public Orthodoxy.
- Positioning: a journalist and religious scholar who spent fifteen years inside the Moscow Patriarchate and now documents its collaboration with state power and religious persecution in Russia.
- Book: "Religious Communities Under Pressure: Documenting Religious Persecution in Russia 2022–2026" by Sergei V. Chapnin, foreword by Rowan Williams. First published June 13, 2026; second, revised and updated edition September 5, 2026. Albion Bixby Publishing, LLC. ISBN 979-8950169038 (paperback, 163 pages). Book page: https://chapnin.org/books/religious-communities-under-pressure/
- How to cite the book: Chapnin, Sergei V. Religious Communities Under Pressure: Documenting Religious Persecution in Russia 2022–2026. Foreword by Rowan Williams. 2nd ed. Albion Bixby Publishing, 2026. ISBN 979-8950169038.
- The former personal site chapnin.ru now redirects to chapnin.org; its Russian texts are at https://chapnin.org/ru/writings/.
- Profiles: Substack https://sobornost.substack.com/ · Public Orthodoxy https://publicorthodoxy.org/author/sergei-chapnin/ · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/vsadnik/ · X https://x.com/sergeichapnin · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/chapnin
